title: Kentucky Revised Statutes Chapter 304, Subtitle 12 - Trade Practices and Frauds (part of the Kentucky Insurance Code)
verified_how: Fetched the KRS index for all 304.x entries: '304.12 Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds'. Then fetched chapter.aspx?id=38701 and confirmed live sections '304.12-230 Unfair claims settlement practices' and '304.12-235 Time of payment of claims'. Page states 'Includes enactments through the 2026 Regular Session'; database updated 09/22/2026.
notes: The Insurance Code is codified as Chapter 304 split into subtitles, each on its own register page; the bare 'Chapter 304' page (chapter.aspx?id=38684) contains only the pre-1970 sections, all repealed in 1970 - do not cite that page. Motor-vehicle first-party claims are additionally governed by Subtitle 304.39 (Motor Vehicle Reparations Act).
